text: Great service both dentist and staff! The price is reasonable which make sense for The Bangna to not come over the city. I have been over for 2 years.

The dentist took the time to genuinely listen to my concerns and never made me feel rushed. The cleaning and whitening process was gentle but thorough, and the whole environment feels very professional, cozy, and comfortable.

Bonus points for letting me listen to my favorite music! Also, the dentists are fluent in English, which was a huge plus. 🙏 If you’re looking for a top-tier dental practice, look no further.

Very calm atmosphere. Pretty architecture and lovely scent. Dental room has a nice view of forest. Arm - the dentist is very attentive and gentle. I could watch Netflix in the room while waiting for teeth whitening. Highly recommend this clinic!
She has a very gentle touch.

The staff were great and very accommodating even though I arrived early for both of my appointments.  English was spoken fluently and all questions were answered with accuracy and professionalism.  Pricing is reasonable for the treatment.  The facility is very modern and state of the art equipment is used.
As a foreigner in Thailand looking for quality dental care I highly recommend Sol Dental Clinic!

Dr. Arm is lovely and kind / The staff are cheerful and smiling / The admin answers questions very quickly. Service is 10/10!

After the dental implant and bone graft, I felt no pain at all the next day and didn't need any painkillers. The doctor even called to check on my condition personally. Very impressed!

I highly recommend this place!

I was a little anxious about going to a Dental Clinic in Bangkok but it was great!
Courteous English speaking staff and Dr Arm was great!
Would go again!
Excellent and extremely friendly service.

This is a great place to go for dental work. It can be hard to spot as it's in the back of a big parking lot, But the service and quality is well worth the trip. They were super helpful with English and even game me a referral to have oral surgery done at the hospital to treat a bad infection. If I have the chance I will definitely be returning.

Well, this place isn't far from our apartment, only about 500 meters away. The entire treatment process felt very thorough and meticulous. The service was excellent, and the environment was even better. In short, I highly recommend this place. By the way, considering the excellent environment, service, and treatment, the price is very reasonable.

I can’t say enough good things about this place. I’m from America and did a lot of research to find a good doctor and location to get my teeth done. First off the location is great. Once you get off the plane at BBK the doctor office is literally only 15 to 40 minutes away depending on traffic you know how that is in Bangkok. So it’s right in between the airport and the chaos of Bangkok. Great location for whatever you want to do it the city. There are some great places to stay that are a 5 minute grab ride away from the office as well. The staff is great the doctor is also great. They were very accommodating for me. I had to have several visits for my procedure and it was always what worked for me. I wish I had this place back home. The price was also very reasonable I spent about 10k usd for what would have cost 40-50k in untied states. All in all great people,place, and location.

text: The clinic is beautiful and very private. I felt so relaxed as soon as I arrived. I had an appointment and didn't have to wait at all. The prices are reasonable, and the doctor has a very gentle touch.
Best dental clinic in Bangkok!

I recently visited Sol Dental Clinic and couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the moment I walked in, K Tae was friendly and welcoming. Dr. Arm was gentle and patient, and took the time to clearly explain my wisdom tooth issue. I highly recommend Sol Dental Clinic to anyone looking for caring and professional dental care.
The staff were very polite and welcoming. The doctor was kind and gave excellent advice and recommendations. The dental work was also excellent; whether it was extraction or filling, it was painless.

Thank you for creating such a wonderful place. I can see all the effort and attention to detail. Now I'm determined to take better care of my teeth, and this will be my go-to dental clinic. :) If you're concerned about cleanliness, equipment, service etiquette, and not just treatment but also aesthetics and meticulous work, I highly recommend this place!

Also, one last thing I want to commend is the management. I learned that they aim to be a dental clinic that doesn't evoke negativity towards clients. Besides respecting privacy, they have a rule against staff joking or gossiping. This is truly beyond amazing! How many places, and how many managers, have such a mindset and consider this a serious matter? I commend them! :D
The place feels relaxing, the doctor is skilled, the service is excellent from the moment you arrive at the reception, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommended.

The atmosphere was wonderful. The staff taking reservations were incredibly helpful. Dr. Arm explained the tooth eruption issues in detail and even taught my two sons how to brush their teeth correctly. He was very friendly and approachable. I was very impressed!

The dentist was incredibly gentle, much gentler than the dentists I've always seen. They have excellent equipment, are experienced in analyzing the cause of my tooth sensitivity, and gave precise recommendations. I've been to two other dentists who couldn't find the cause.
The best dental clinic. The doctor is very kind.

Very satisfying service. Its might be cheaper than same treatment at my Country Indonesia. Very humble doctor Arm for take care my issue and schedule mostly follow my schedule.

Btw, today go to clinic for checking and administration issue with very good support and thanks for the cocholate gift Doc!

Location is easy to reach, luckily near my condo, only walk 200mts🤣
Suggest you to go this clinic with valued services
The atmosphere was great. The doctor was gentle and the service was excellent.

I went there today for the first time to have my teeth cleaned. From the moment I arrived until I left, everything was top-notch! The dentist deserves special mention; he took his time, explained everything, and was incredibly professional! We'll definitely be back next year! Thank you so much!

The dentist is very kind and gentle. The clinic atmosphere is nice and relaxing, which helped reduce my anxiety about dental treatment. If you live nearby or are looking for a dental clinic, I highly recommend it.

The atmosphere is fantastic; it feels like a cafe. The decor is beautiful, the staff are polite and provide excellent service, and the dentist gave great advice and was very gentle. This is now my favorite regular clinic!

A new dental clinic has opened near our house, and they have a specialist pediatric dentist.

The clinic is beautiful and clean, the dentist is kind, and the work is excellent. The children cooperated very well during their checkups and fluoride treatments.

Choosing the right clinic and dentist for your child is very important, as it will be their first dental experience. If the children are happy the first few times, they are less likely to refuse future visits.

For those in the Bang Na area, I recommend SOL Dental Clinic. It's easy to get to, has convenient parking, and the children are happy, making mom and dad happy too! ❤️
The clinic is very beautiful and clean! 🤗 …
The doctor was very gentle and cleaned every nook and cranny well. I liked it. The clinic is beautiful.

text: This dental clinic breaks all the rules! It's as beautiful as a five-star hotel, the location is very convenient, and there's plenty of parking. The young man/woman at the front desk is incredibly cute and has amazing service mind (10/10/10). The treatment rooms are like suites – modern equipment, clean, and minimalistly decorated. The dentist is gentle, and the prices are reasonable for what you get. Scaling is 1300 baht, fillings are 2000 baht. I walked in without an appointment, but everything was quick and efficient. Excellent service. I'm entrusting my teeth to them! Love it!

Dr. Kant listened to my problem, fixed and removed the filling with a sincere attention I had never experienced before. Thank you very much from the bottom of my heart. They also have a saliva-repelling device, which I've used for the first …
The doctor is cute, the service is good, the atmosphere is good, and the staff are cute.

Location: The clinic is beautiful and clean, easy to get to, and parking is convenient.
Treatment: The doctor gave me straightforward advice and explained the treatment limitations in a very thorough and informative manner.
Service: The admin/assistant was lovely and didn't push or push me.
Very impressed. Will definitely come back again.
Excellent service. The clinic has a nice atmosphere and is clean.

Accidentally stopped at the wrong clinic on the way to Sol Dental.  After arriving at the right clinic (Sol Dental) I was able to compare the two offices. Sol Dental was presented much better. Everything was clean, staff was immediately there to help. Just walking in to the clinic was a much much better experience.
And then the doctor showed up quickly to introduce himself. A very pleasant fellow.
After my examination, I was very impressed with the whole experience. Very professional, answered my questions, and spent as much time with me as needed.
I would definitely return.

This clinic is so comfortable for an introvert like me. The staff are amazing, the doctor is gentle and attentive to detail, and provides excellent advice. I love this place! 🤍 …
Very good service. The doctor has a very gentle hand.

This is a clinic with an amazing vibe. The doctors and staff are very service-minded. I highly recommend it if you're looking for a clinic for your little one. This place makes going to the dentist fun for both the little ones and the parents. 🥰 …
I was impressed from the moment I stepped into the clinic. The reception staff were very nice. The doctor gave good advice.
The service was excellent.

My wife and I came here for the first time today, and the exterior of the building was so impressive that I couldn't believe it was a dental clinic! The parking lot in front of the building is spacious, so parking wasn't a concern. The doctor was Thai and very friendly! Anyway, my wife (from Thailand) was very satisfied even though she came in a hurry, so I highly recommend it! ♡

Absolutely  the best dental experience  i have ever had !
Appointment was for 11 am i arrived at 10:35 am was seen by Dr in 5 minutes broken tooth fixed and out the door in a total.of 35 minutes!!! …
The dental clinic is clean, the staff are very attentive and caring, and the dentist is kind and provides continuous care throughout the treatment. I highly recommend it!
This is a really great dental clinic. I was impressed from the dentist to the staff. :))

This is probably the best dental clinic in Thailand. Usually, people are afraid of the noise and stressed about the pain when going to the dentist, but at SOL, as soon as you enter, you're greeted with a pleasant aroma.
The soft, soothing music plays in the background. The place is spacious and incredibly clean. The moment you open the door, the receptionist is smiling, offers you a small bottle of mineral water, takes your blood pressure, and chats in a friendly manner. You completely forget you're there for dental work! Hahaha, it's like getting a Thai massage. And that's not all. Once the doctor is ready, as soon as you enter the room, the first thing you see is two nurses and the doctor, all bowing respectfully and greeting patients in a friendly way—they all bowed in perfect unison! The view in the back is of lush, green trees, very relaxing and pleasing to the eye. The doctor invites you to sit in the patient chair, and in front of you is a monitor displaying "Welcome, Mr./Ms./Ms./Mr./Ms ... After they finished, they checked my teeth again to see if there were any problems with any other teeth. I was very impressed. Normally, if it's another place, I'd be put off for a while afterward, but here, I feel like I really want to go back here for dental work again. Excellent!

Great dental clinic!
Gentle dentist, friendly staff, and a calm, private atmosphere. Highly recommend 🤎 …

It was an hour's drive here, but totally worth it for my dental work. The clinic is incredibly clean, the dentist is kind and gentle, constantly asking if I'm okay. I'm usually afraid of dentists, but I felt so comfortable here. The staff were also fantastic. This will definitely be my regular clinic.
